notes.title: Version 1.1 released!
notes.content:
The first major update to Baratrum since release contains a lot exciting changes.

Features:
- Limbs can be removed when killed by an enemy
- New tile added - rocky inferno
- New enemy added - Eyenoid demon, shoots a laser from it's eye.
- Updated textures with normal and roughness maps
- New screen shader VFX 
- Player now has a torch
- Added a cursor when aiming
- Humans now drop from the sky
- Player starts by getting up, rather than a spawn FX
- New environmental music
- New environment assets
- Ascending will give player XP for the number of saves just the same as when the player dies

Fixes
- Humans don't overlap each other
- Enemy will target closest target rather than just the player
- Uses new physics engine to improve performance
- Audio levels of some sound FX
- Removed cursor shown when a gamepad is plugged in

Additional
- Added support for DLCs
